entities.summary: Singhasari, a notable figure in the history of Indonesia, associated with Classical Javanese Kingdoms (929–1293). Preceded by Construction of Prambanan, the largest Hindu temple in Southeast Asia and Construction of Borobudur, the world's largest Buddhist monument. Their legacy influenced Ken Arok founds the Singhasari kingdom, unifying East Java and Kertanegara defies Kublai Khan's demands, triggering the Mongol invasion of Java.
